title: Design Facebook News Feed
description: Model posts, users, likes, comments, and feed generation with ranking.

data.text: Design a news feed system like Facebook. Users create posts, follow other users, like/comment on posts, and see a ranked feed of posts from people they follow.
User, Post, Comment, Like, and FeedService are the core building blocks. Post supports text, images, and videos. FeedService pulls posts from followed users and ranks them.

data.title: User, Post, and FeedService
Why EngagementScore?
data.text: Pure recency is boring. EngagementScore blends likes, comments, and recency so viral posts float to the top. The -0.1 per hour ensures old content fades.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: User.Following is the social graph edge list
FeedService pulls from followed users and sorts
Pagination prevents loading 10,000 posts at once
data.takeaway: A feed is just a sorted merge of posts from people you follow. Add engagement scoring to make it feel intelligent.
